Bytebox help menu:

<> - Required argument
[] - Optional elements

help - show this menu

read - print the entire database

get/
    get <column> <row>    - print an element from the database
    getcol <column>       - print a column from the database
    getrow <row>         - print a row from the database

add/
    add [elements]        - add a new row to the database
    addcol <column_name>  - add a new column to the database

delete/
    delete <column> <row> - delete an element from the database
    delrow <column>       - delete a column from the database
    delline <row>         - delete a row from the database
